title: Add the cove and picture-light fixtures
author: claude
summary: A hidden-light ledge near the ceiling and picture lights above the art.
what: We added a ledge near the ceiling that hides a strip of light (the cove), and fixtures for the picture lights above the art. They are in both the day and the evening room.
why: The evening mood needs real places for its lights to come from.
how: The new parts are named `wall_*_cove_*` and `art_light_*` in `build_room.py`. Because they are also in the day room, the day room needs a rebake to show them.

tech.name: Blender
tech.plain: Free 3D software. We use it to build the room and to calculate how light falls in it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
